page.layout: One page of text in a single column. A running text ends with a catchword at the lower right. No marginal notes. The right edge shows a neighbouring page and show-through, which are not transcribed.

main_text.p: relegi, Auctoris eruditionem ac diligentiam admiratus. Certe fuit operae pretium Romanae Ecclesiae calumniatores, etiam ab ipsis hostibus, quod egregie praestitit Allatius, sumptis argumentis convincere. Quare docta huic Commentationi Davidicum illud meo iudicio ὑποσχοι ἂν ης δικαίως[?] יִסְפַּר פִּי דִּבְרֵי עֵקֶר[?] Gratias igitur tibi maximas ago, Praesul Reueren-diffime, quod mihi eam legendi copiam feceris. Vale.
main_text.head: FORTVNIVS LICETVS Eidem.
main_text.p: Leo Allatius, Reuerendissime Domine, secundo Maximi Pontificis Vrbani VIII. Spiritu nixus, & mira sua eruditione, summaque iudicii solertia, seu geminis intellectus alis, adeo sublime scandere potuit, vt celsissimum antiquitatis Olympum superauerit; ibique lectas in Ara Historicae veritati dicata, densis ignorantiae nubibus, ventosisque malitiae turbinibus inaccessa, priscorum scriptiones non altero tantum anno, sed multis retro seculis exaratas ad nos tandem retulit incorruptas, quibus vt de Ioanna Papissa vulgatam aliquando famam vere fabulam esse conuincit, ita Leo my-sticus interemit Hæreseos vrsam, quae fidelem ca-

page.notes: Greek line after "meo iudicio" is partly unclear: the first word and the rest of the Greek phrase are read as ὑποσχοι ἂν ης δικαίως with uncertainty. The Hebrew after it is uncertain as well and is marked [?]. "Hæreseos" may show an æ ligature that is hard to see; it is given as printed. The top of the page has no running head. Faint marks and stains in the lower left and centre are not text.
